<ark...@ugcs.caltech.edu> wrote:

>> It (swallowed by the night)), as a combat card, can be played on th SCS, sure.

>> The SCS cannot use it, however, since the only effect he is allowed to
>> use is not a combat effect.

>He can use it to gain 1 stealth during combat, as per card text, right? Of
>course, the stealth would be useless to him.

No, you cannot gain stealth if you do not need it.

6.2.2.2 Defintion of Stealth and Intercept (Resolve Any Block
Attempts)

"Stealth can be added to an action only when needed (that is, only if
the action is currently being blocked and the blocking minion has
enough intercept to block the acting minion). "

If you are in combat, you are not "currently being blocked", you have
been blocked or are blocking (or neither for a rush action that
remains unblocked).

Carpe noctem.
